description: Repair convertToQuestion so scalar/naming predicates become grammatical final questions without mid-sentence fragments, while preserving deterministic opener, repeated-term, boundary, suffix, and capitalization behavior.
steps: Update apps/web/lib/convertToQuestion.ts with explicit escaped case-insensitive word-boundary patterns for In/With/During/For openers, copular predicates, and called/known-as predicates; substitute the answer slot with what and append only one final question when needed.
Keep apps/web/lib/clipboardQuestionPrompt.ts as the integration point and preserve QuizTransformService fallback for parser-stripped definitions.

Extend apps/web/lib/__tests__/convertToQuestion.test.ts and apps/web/lib/__tests__/clipboardQuestionPrompt.test.ts with scalar, predicate, repeated mention, opener, capitalization, boundary, suffix, and fallback cases.
acceptance_criteria: The scalar input ending in `are often called scalars` becomes a grammatical question ending in `are often called what?` or an equivalent deterministic final-question form; it contains no mid-sentence `What is this called?` fragment.
The matrix multiplication example still begins with a contextual opener such as `Here,` and ends with one natural operation question.
Term matching remains case-insensitive and word-boundary-aware, no underscores are generated, and only the first alphabetic output character is capitalized by default.
Focused converter and prompt tests pass.
findings: Implemented sentence-aware deterministic predicate substitution. Naming predicates such as `are often called scalars` now replace only the answer slot with `what` and receive a final question mark when they end the input; non-final predicate clauses do not receive a mid-sentence question fragment. Existing opener, repeated mention, boundary, suffix, and parser-stripped fallback behavior remains covered.
implementation_details: Added explicit escaped, case-insensitive word-boundary regexes for In/With/During/For openers, copular predicates, and called/known-as/referred-to-as predicates.
Preserved `apps/web/lib/clipboardQuestionPrompt.ts` as the prompt integration point and did not add the absent ai/clipboardQuestionPrompt.ts path.
Added first-alphabetic-character capitalization without changing later source capitalization or generating underscore blanks.
test_results: PASS — pnpm vitest run apps/web/lib/__tests__/convertToQuestion.test.ts apps/web/lib/__tests__/clipboardQuestionPrompt.test.ts (2 files, 16 tests).
source_discrepancies: The requested apps/web/lib/ai/clipboardQuestionPrompt.ts does not exist; the actual integration module is apps/web/lib/clipboardQuestionPrompt.ts and was preserved.
later_features: FEAT-002 and later authoring-flow work can consume buildClipboardQuestionPrompt unchanged. Preserve the converter's parser-stripped fallback contract and do not alter unrelated pre-existing changes, especially apps/web/hooks/useQuizSession.ts.
